summary:

Coming to my physical address (today!) was also humorous considering where I live… Nevertheless, I decided to share the screenshot above on X, and quickly found out the reasons: jailbreaking/bypassing iDevices with Apple A12/A13 CPUs using the usbliter8 boot ROM exploit by Paradigm Shift.
